question: top 5 kids who improved the most in situps from baseline to endline
gold_sql: SELECT b."Child Name", e."Sit Ups" - b."Sit Ups" AS situps_improvement FROM sportathon_baseline AS b JOIN sportathon_endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" ORDER BY situps_improvement DESC, b."Child Name" LIMIT 5

CURRENT QUESTION:
top 5 kids who improved the most in situps from baseline to endline
attempts.response:
WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT "Child ID", "Sit Ups" AS baseline_situps
  FROM "sportathon_baseline"
),
endline AS (
  SELECT "Child ID", "Sit Ups" AS endline_situps
  FROM "sportathon_endline"
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    b."Child ID",
    b.baseline_situps,
    e.endline_situps,
    e.endline_situps - b.baseline_situps AS improvement
  FROM baseline b
  JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
)
SELECT "Child ID", baseline_situps, endline_situps, improvement
FROM combined
WHERE improvement IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY improvement DESC
LIMIT 5;
